title: Valid Parentheses
summary: Determine whether every opening bracket is closed in the correct order.
algorithmSteps: Push each opening bracket onto a stack.
For a closing bracket, pop the stack and compare it with the required opener.
The string is valid only when every comparison succeeds and the stack ends empty.

examples.explanation: Every closing bracket matches the most recent unmatched opener.

edgeCases: A closing bracket cannot appear before its opener.
A leftover opening bracket makes the string invalid.
